title: KODAK INVENTED IT. NEVER SOLD IT.
caption: Kodak invented it. Never sold it.

beats.name: THE HOOK
beats.vo: Kodak invented it. Never sold it.
beats.visual: The words land on the page one at a time, then hold completely still.
beats.text: KODAK INVENTED IT. NEVER SOLD IT.
beats.question: What did they invent that they refused to sell?
beats.hook: KODAK INVENTED IT. NEVER SOLD IT.

beats.name: THE INVENTOR
beats.vo: 1975. Steve Sasson builds it. Point one megapixels. Toaster-sized.
beats.visual: A timeline draws itself across the page: 1975, one dot, one toaster-sized box.
beats.reveal: Steve Sasson built the first portable digital camera — 1975, 0.1 megapixels, the size of a toaster

beats.name: THE MECHANISM
beats.vo: The problem? Film was 90% of Kodak's money. Every digital photo kills a print.
beats.visual: Two bars race across the page side by side against each other, one nearly full while the other barely moves.
beats.reveal: Film was 90% of Kodak's money — every digital photo would kill a print

beats.name: THE COMPETITORS
beats.vo: So they shelved it. While Sony, Canon and Fuji marched right past.
beats.visual: Three icon cards step in one at a time and hold.
beats.question: Why did Kodak just watch?
beats.reveal: Kodak shelved the camera while Sony, Canon and Fuji built the market it refused

beats.name: THE COLLAPSE
beats.vo: 2012. Chapter 11. Six billion dollars in debt. The company that invented the camera goes bankrupt.
beats.visual: One big number slams onto the page and holds.
beats.question: How does the company that invented it die?
beats.reveal: The company that invented the camera filed for bankruptcy — 2012, Chapter 11, six billion in debt

beats.name: THE WEAPON
beats.vo: The weapon that could have saved them? They built it. All the way back in 1975.
beats.visual: A single word card cuts onto the page and holds, waiting.
beats.question: The weapon that could have saved them?
beats.reveal: The weapon that could have saved them was the one they buried — 1975

beats.name: THE PAYOFF
beats.vo: The weapon that could have saved them all? Kodak invented it. They never sold a single one of them. It cost them everything. 1975.
beats.visual: The headline lands on the page and holds. A highlighter sweeps over it.
beats.motion: A hand swipes a highlighter over the line.
beats.text: THEY INVENTED IT. NEVER SOLD IT.
beats.reveal: They built the weapon that could have saved them — Kodak invented it, never sold it, 1975

texts.text: KODAK INVENTED IT. NEVER SOLD IT.
THEY INVENTED IT. NEVER SOLD IT.
